semiconductor_relevance: High — The company manufactures essential components and materials used in semiconductor manufacturing equipment.
summary: Chongqing GENORI Technology Co., Ltd. manufactures components and materials crucial for semiconductor manufacturing, including silicon, quartz, silicon carbide, and alumina ceramics. Their products are integral to processes like plasma etching and thin film deposition, serving both the integrated circuit and display panel industries.
capabilities: Manufacturing of silicon, quartz, silicon carbide, and alumina ceramic components
Surface treatment services such as melt spray regeneration and anodizing
Production of large-diameter single-crystal silicon rods and polycrystalline silicon rods
High-purity silicon carbide ultra-thick materials via chemical vapor deposition
